arithmetic: round_fp16((uint4_w-uint4_zero)*FP16_group_scale) -> new symmetric per-output-channel INT8 weights; per-token symmetric INT8 activation; whole-K INT32 GEMM; FP32 (integer*row_scale)*channel_scale; FP16 output
scope: Independent requantization experiment, not same-weight W4A16 equivalence and not a reproduction of QServe or QQQ. Original checkpoint/package/runtime remain unchanged. Microprobe only; no full-model adapter.

predeclared_gates.implementation: Selected 4 rows and 8 columns: CPU NumPy int64 dot must equal GPU INT32 exactly. CPU FP32 ordered epilogue and FP16 result bytes must match. CPU packed dequant/weight quantization selected columns and activation quantization selected rows must match actual GPU data. Full INT32 and FP16 output bytes repeat across eager/graph and hot/cold.

approximation_screen.reference: Independent FP16-rounded W4 weights with FP32 matmul, TF32 disabled, then FP16 output
approximation_screen.qualification: Predeclared random-projection screening threshold only. Not full-model accuracy, actual activation accuracy, token equivalence or navigation quality.

repeatability.comparison: Full tensor bytewise GPU equality, outside timed intervals, with first output SHA and per-repeat booleans.

predeclared_gates.advance: All implementation/approximation/stability cases pass for a layout/shape, and full pipeline hot and cold P50 each improve >=3% vs frozen W4A16 and same-W4 dequantized FP16 GEMM. Micro promising shapes never constitute service approval.

timing.primary: CUDA graph replay of activation quantization + whole-K _int_mm + FP32 scale/FP16 output. Include explicit padding work if enabled.

source_findings.finding: CUDA _int_mm requires M>16 and positive K,N divisible by8, contiguous INT32 output. M701/2815 need no source-level M padding. Dense row/column strides are forwarded; unusual strides may clone, so explicit layouts only. Source warns about some transposed combinations; actual execution still required.

int8_gemm uses cuBLASLt INT8 operands/INT32 compute and output, alpha1/beta0; CUDA branch passes null algorithm and zero workspace. Private API locked to installed2.5.1; no claim this selects fastest hardware kernel.

Supports investigating inner-loop dequantization overhead and moving whole-K scaling to an epilogue. Its QoQ progressive quantization is a different algorithm, not available merely by repacking existing asymmetric group128 W4.

QQQ identifies the challenge of accelerating both prefill and decode and uses smoothing/Hessian compensation plus W4A8 kernels. Our startup W8 re-quantization does not reproduce those accuracy mechanisms or reported gains.

next_if_promising: Actual model excluded smokes require real per-layer activation approximation/error and parsed outputs, then original policy20 quality plus matching latency conditions; no exact-W4 token claim. Inspect actual VRAM first, retain original checkpoint and KV64x64.
implementation_notes: Runtime quant/epilogue M uses do_not_specialize and actual bounds; K/N constexpr. No per-exact-M specialization is intended.
Weight scale division and requantization use explicit Triton tl.div_rn and cvt.rni, matching the strict CPU IEEE FP32/RNE reference; torch only computes exact half-to-float/abs/max.
Additional semantic boundaries: signed maximum-K dot, zero rows/weights and ties-to-even; default remains no M padding.
